subject: general
question: In Gymnastics, women have ____ apparatus used during competitions.
solution:
The correct answer is __**4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Women's Artistic Gymnastics (WAG)** is a discipline where athletes compete on four distinct apparatuses designed to test strength, balance, and agility.
 
• **Vault**: This event requires the gymnast to sprint down a **25-meter** runway, launch from a springboard, and perform acrobatic maneuvers after pushing off a **Vaulting Table**.
 
• **Uneven Bars**: Athletes perform continuous swinging motions, transitions, and release moves between two horizontal bars set at different heights, specifically **1.7 meters** and **2.5 meters** from the floor.
 
• **Balance Beam**: This apparatus is only **10 centimeters wide** and stands **1.25 meters** high; gymnasts must execute a routine of leaps, flips, and turns without falling.
 
• **Floor Exercise**: Performed on a **12×12 meter** spring floor, this is the only event where female gymnasts perform to **musical accompaniment**, combining dance elements with tumbling passes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Federation of Gymnastics (FIG)**:

 
 
• The **FIG** is the global governing body that establishes the **Code of Points** used to score performances.
 
• In **Men's Artistic Gymnastics (MAG)**, athletes compete on **6 apparatuses**: Floor Exercise, Pommel Horse, Still Rings, Vault, Parallel Bars, and Horizontal Bar.
 
 
 
• **Olympic History**:
 
 
• Gymnastics has been a staple of the **Modern Olympic Games** since **1896**.
 
• Women's events were officially introduced during the **1928 Amsterdam Olympics**.
